description:
Our client is looking for an experienced Founding Engineer to build a production-grade Voice AI legal intake platform. 
 
 This is the first engineering hire . The immediate challenge isn't simply building another AI prototype. It's taking an existing prototype and making it reliable enough for sensitive, real-world legal conversations where failures, privacy issues, or incorrect routing have meaningful consequences.
 
 The Founding Engineer will also be forward-deployed: as the founder signs law firms, this engineer will ensure the Voice AI system actually works inside each firm's environment.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Take an existing conversational Voice AI intake receptionist from founder-built prototype → production 
 Production-grade infrastructure for live AI-powered client calls
 Embedded web-based legal intake
 Privacy and security controls for sensitive legal conversations
 Infrastructure supporting sensitive client-fund workflows
 Referral platform connecting attorneys, partner firms, and referred clients
 Telephony integrations with partner law firms
 Existing phone-system integrations
 IVR configuration/integration
 Additional AI workflows based directly on partner-firm feedback
 Reliability and production monitoring for high-stakes AI conversations
 Requirements 
 The Ideal Candidate: 
 The strongest target is likely an Applied AI / Voice AI engineer with 4–8+ years of engineering experience who has personally shipped production systems and wants founding-level ownership. 
 
 Requirements 
 4+ years of professional software engineering experience 
 Recent applied AI experience at a strong company 
 Voice AI or telephony exposure is highly important 
 Proven ability to take an AI prototype into a reliable production system serving real users
 Strong full-stack capability with ability to own the product end-to-end
 Production experience involving privacy and security
 Comfortable building workflows involving sensitive information and client funds
 Strong customer-facing ability
 Able to personally install/integrate the product into customer environments
 Comfortable working with existing phone systems and telephony integrations
 San Francisco Bay Area or willing to relocate 
 Minimum 4 days/week in-office 
 Comfortable with an intense founding-stage schedule beyond a conventional 9-to-5
 Benefits 
 Salary: $250,000
 Equity: 10% 
 Additional benefits disclosed during interview process
